validity_findings: V1-DETERMINISM HOLDS: The fixture is an in-process stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:0 with fixed JSON responses. No RNG, wall-clock, or external network. Induced support regex ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$ and confidence 0.9 are deterministic arithmetic functions of the 5 induction observations (item-001..item-005). Verified in run_certificate.out.json observations and runner code (prereg.md section 14).

V2-CREDENTIAL-FREE HOLDS: model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0 asserted in D3_COUNTERS (PASS). The only HTTP activity is exactly 1 loopback GET to the fixture (observed in transcript and run_certificate.log). No API keys, browser, or external egress. Verified in run_certificate.out.json counters and transcript.

V3-IDENTITY-THREE-PART HOLDS: (i) pre-install sha256 46929b3a... == shipped literal blob cfec9866... (allowed set {literal, carrier}); (ii) carrier source sha256 718efa6a... == frozen identity blob b15ed848...; (iii) post-install file bytes == git blob b15ed848... and file sha256 718efa6a... Verified in run_certificate.out.json identities and runner D0_IDENTITY clause.

V4-STOP-TRIGGER NOT FIRED: Identity certificate held on first attempt (D0_IDENTITY PASS). The stop trigger (substituted carrier -> BLOCKED, kernel untouched) was demonstrated in DESIGN probes (design_reasoning.json checks) but correctly did not fire in EXECUTE. This is correct behavior.

V5-HELD-OUT-INSIDE-SUPPORT HOLDS: Unseen item-007 (single-digit suffix) is inside induced support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$ and resolved EXECUTABLE@0.9. The audited failure-mode id item-010 (two-digit suffix) is correctly used as out-of-support negative. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D1_POSITIVE and D2_NEGATIVE.

V6-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS HOLDS: All 7 probes have bound_action=null, non-empty reason, status!=EXECUTABLE. Out-of-support (3) and missing-parameter (2) are EXPLORE with correct reason class ('support'/'parameter'). Wrong-intent (delete_item) and no-applicable (never_seen_intent) are EXACTLY UNKNOWN. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D2_NEGATIVE.negatives array.

V7-TRANSCRIPT-HONESTY HOLDS AT FROZEN SNAPSHOT: At the D3 snapshot (after rebind, before replay), transcript has 8 resolve + 1 rebind = 9 retrieval calls, 1 verify, 1 repair. Counters match exactly (retrieval_calls=9, verification_calls=1, repair_attempts=1). The 5 replay resolves occur after the snapshot; final kernel state would be retrieval=14 but the frozen decision rule checks at the rebind point matching prereg probe values. This is explicitly disclosed in result.json validity_notes and is by design.

V8-FREEZE-BINDING HOLDS (EXECUTE MODE): freeze.json present and readable; sha256(prereg.md) == freeze.json.hashes['prereg.md'] (019c88f5...); running runner source == FROZEN RUNNER block (sha256 a114804c...); all 5 freeze artifact hashes match. Verified in run_certificate.out.json V8_FREEZE_BINDING clause.
V9-REGRESSION HOLDS: tests/test_kernel.py suite 3/3 (0 failures, 0 errors) on installed carrier. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D4_CONTROLS.regression and run_certificate.log stderr.

V10-ABLATION-ATTRIBUTION HOLDS: Literal kernel (blob cfec9866..., sha256 46929b3a...) loaded in hermetic temp package with same models.py/registry.py/__init__.py has has_distill_parameterized == false. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D4_CONTROLS.literal_ablation. This supports causal attribution of the positive certificate to the installed carrier.

DISCLOSED LIMITATIONS (unchanged from prereg §11, no new threats observed): (i) Induced support is a conservative char-class/quantifier inference; the bank exploits this deliberately (single-digit positives, two-digit negatives). (ii) Fixture is a minimal REST server; execution correctness verified only for the GET/JSON shape the induction encodes. (iii) Latent pretrained knowledge of the carrier's source cannot be excluded; attribution rests on byte-pinned blob identity plus literal ablation, not authorship narratives. These are explicitly disclosed and do not invalidate the certificate within its declared scope.

NO LEAKAGE DETECTED: The treatment (carrier installation) and measurement are properly isolated. The literal ablation runs in a hermetic temp package with independent module reload (sys.path manipulation + drop_module). The fixture is in-process and ephemeral. The freeze binding (V8) ensures the runner, prereg, and artifacts are exactly the frozen versions. No external state or prior runs contaminate the measurement.
baseline_findings: B-LITERAL-KERNEL (ablation): Structural distinction verified. Literal kernel (132 lines, blob cfec9866..., no distill_parameterized, confidence floor 0.5 < min_confidence 0.8) vs carrier (491 lines, blob b15ed848..., has distill_parameterized, confidence 0.9 path). Loaded in hermetic temp package from frozen blob with same models/registry/__init__.py. has_distill_parameterized == false confirmed. This is a strong attribution baseline — the positive certificate is impossible on the ablation, confirming the installed carrier is the cause.

B-PRE-INSTALL-KERNEL (identity baseline): Pre-install sha256 46929b3a... matches shipped literal (first run). This is the correct precondition for the certificate. Any other state would have triggered BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID per D0/P0 gate. Verified in run_certificate.out.json identities.pre_install_sha256.

PC-EXACT-REPLAY (positive control): 5/5 training ids (item-001..item-005) re-resolve EXECUTABLE on installed carrier. This anchors the learned mechanism identity and confirms the carrier preserves behavior on the induction set. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D4_CONTROLS.pc_exact_replay.

NC-OUT-OF-SUPPORT-ID (null control): 3/3 probes (item-010, item-999, item-xyz) -> EXPLORE with reason containing 'support', bound_action null. The support boundary is correctly enforced. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D2_NEGATIVE.negatives[0..2].

NC-MISSING-PARAMETER (null control): 2/2 probes ({}, {'wrong_key':'x'}) -> EXPLORE with reason containing 'parameter', bound_action null. Parameter requirement correctly enforced. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D2_NEGATIVE.negatives[3..4].

NC-WRONG-INTENT (null control): delete_item with valid params -> EXACTLY UNKNOWN with reason 'no applicable validated mechanism', bound_action null. Mandate clause (b) satisfied. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D2_NEGATIVE.negatives[5].

NC-NO-APPLICABLE-MECHANISM (null control): never_seen_intent -> EXACTLY UNKNOWN with reason 'no applicable validated mechanism', bound_action null. Mandate clause (b) satisfied. Verified in run_certificate.out.json D2_NEGATIVE.negatives[6].

ALL CONTROLS EXERCISED WITH CONCRETE FAILURE MODES: Design_review.json demonstrates each control has a reachable failure mode under the same code path (e.g., substituted carrier -> D0 FAIL/BLOCKED; tampered freeze.json -> V8 FAIL/BLOCKED; literal ablation would FAIL if it unexpectedly had distill_parameterized). The control set is non-vacuous.
